requirements.statement: A shopper must be able to register an account with an email and password.

criteria.must: A new visitor can register with an email address and password
Registration rejects an email address that is already registered

requirements.statement: A shopper must be able to sign in and sign out of their account.

criteria.must: A registered shopper can sign in with their credentials
A signed-in shopper can sign out and is no longer treated as authenticated

requirements.statement: The system must require sign-in to complete checkout, while allowing catalog browsing and cart use without sign-in.

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor can browse the product catalog
An unauthenticated visitor attempting to complete checkout is required to sign in first

requirements.statement: A shopper must be able to view and update their own profile information.

criteria.must: A signed-in shopper can view their profile information
A signed-in shopper can update their profile information and see the change persisted

requirements.statement: The system must support password reset for shoppers who forget their credentials.

criteria.must: A shopper can initiate a password reset from a forgotten-password entry point
Completing the password reset flow allows the shopper to sign in with the new password

requirements.statement: The seller/admin must authenticate separately, with access restricted to catalog, inventory, and order-management functions not available to shoppers.

criteria.must: The seller can sign in to a distinct admin area
A shopper account cannot access seller-only catalog, inventory, or order-management functions

requirements.statement: The catalog must display products with name, description, price, images, category/tags, and current stock quantity.

criteria.must: A product listing shows its name, price, category, and stock status
A product detail page shows its description and image(s)

requirements.statement: Shoppers must be able to browse, view product detail, and search/filter products.

criteria.must: A shopper can view a single product's detail page from the catalog
A shopper can filter or search the catalog and see matching results

requirements.statement: An out-of-stock product must be clearly indicated and must not be addable to the cart.

criteria.must: A product with zero stock quantity is visibly marked as out of stock
An out-of-stock product cannot be added to the cart

requirements.statement: The seller must be able to create, edit, publish/unpublish, and delete products.

criteria.must: The seller can create a new product with price, description, images, category, and stock quantity
The seller can edit an existing product's details
The seller can publish or unpublish a product, and an unpublished product does not appear in the shopper-facing catalog
The seller can delete a product

requirements.statement: The seller must be able to adjust a product's stock quantity directly.

criteria.must: The seller can change a product's stock quantity and see the new value reflected

requirements.statement: A shopper (or anonymous visitor) can add a product to a cart with a chosen quantity.

criteria.must: A visitor can add a product to the cart with a specified quantity

requirements.statement: The cart must prevent adding or increasing quantity beyond the product's available stock.

criteria.must: Adding a quantity greater than the available stock is rejected or capped at the available stock
Increasing a cart line item's quantity beyond available stock is rejected

requirements.statement: A shopper must be able to view the cart, update line-item quantities, and remove line items.

criteria.must: A shopper can view the current contents of their cart
A shopper can update a cart line item's quantity
A shopper can remove a line item from the cart

requirements.statement: The cart must display a running subtotal that updates as items change.

criteria.must: The cart subtotal updates correctly when a line item's quantity changes or a line item is removed

requirements.statement: A signed-in shopper's cart contents must persist across sessions/devices.

criteria.must: A signed-in shopper's cart contents are still present after signing out and back in

requirements.statement: Checkout must require the shopper to be signed in.

criteria.must: Checkout cannot be completed without an authenticated shopper session

requirements.statement: Checkout must collect or reuse a saved shipping address.

criteria.must: A shopper can enter a shipping address during checkout
A shopper with a saved address can reuse it during checkout instead of re-entering it

requirements.statement: Checkout must apply a single flat-rate shipping fee (no carrier-calculated shipping or local pickup).

criteria.must: The same flat shipping fee is applied to orders regardless of destination or item weight

requirements.statement: Checkout must display an order summary with line items, subtotal, shipping fee, tax, and total before payment confirmation.

criteria.must: The checkout screen shows line items, subtotal, shipping fee, tax, and total before the shopper confirms payment

requirements.statement: Checkout must process payment through an integrated payment provider without the store storing raw card details.

criteria.must: A successful checkout payment is processed through the integrated payment provider
The store does not persist raw payment card numbers

requirements.statement: At order placement, the system must re-validate stock and decrement it on successful payment.

criteria.must: Stock availability is re-checked for every cart line item at the moment of order placement
Product stock quantities are decremented after a successful payment

requirements.statement: If payment fails, the order must not be created, stock must not be decremented, and the shopper must see an actionable error with a retry option.

criteria.must: A declined payment does not create an order
A declined payment does not decrement product stock
The shopper sees an actionable error and can retry after a declined payment

requirements.statement: If stock is insufficient at order-placement time, the shopper must be informed and affected line items adjusted or removed before completion.

criteria.must: A shopper is informed when an item's stock becomes insufficient during checkout
The affected line item must be adjusted or removed before the order can be completed

requirements.statement: Upon successful payment, the system must create an order, show confirmation, and clear the cart.

criteria.must: A successful payment creates an order record
The shopper sees an order confirmation after successful payment
The purchased items are cleared from the cart after successful payment

requirements.statement: A signed-in shopper must be able to view their own order history and each order's detail/status.

criteria.must: A signed-in shopper can view a list of their own past orders
A signed-in shopper can view the detail and status of one of their own past orders

requirements.statement: The seller must be able to view all orders with detail and update fulfillment status.

criteria.must: The seller can view a list of all orders across all shoppers
The seller can view an order's items, shopper, shipping address, and payment status
The seller can update an order's fulfillment status

requirements.statement: The system must notify the shopper by email on order confirmation and shipment.

criteria.must: The shopper receives an email notification when an order is confirmed
The shopper receives an email notification when an order ships

requirements.statement: The store must never receive or persist raw payment card data.

criteria.must: No raw card number field is stored anywhere in the store's own data

requirements.statement: Concurrent purchases must not oversell a product below zero available stock.

criteria.must: Two concurrent checkouts for the last unit of a product result in only one succeeding

requirements.statement: Every order must retain an immutable record of items, prices, and shipping fee at time of purchase, independent of later catalog changes.

criteria.must: Changing a product's price after an order was placed does not change the price recorded on that past order
